commands.name: devenv_flake_lockfiles
commands.cmd: echo '$ test -f devenv.lock -a -f flake.lock'; test -f devenv.lock -a -f flake.lock && echo LOCKS_PRESENT; echo '$ python3 -c json.load(devenv.lock)+json.load(flake.lock)'; python3 -c "import json;json.load(open('devenv.lock'));json.load(open('flake.lock'));print('LOCKS_VALID_JSON')"; echo '$ devenv version'; timeout 60 devenv version
commands.stdout_excerpt:
$ test -f devenv.lock -a -f flake.lock
LOCKS_PRESENT
$ python3 -c json.load(devenv.lock)+json.load(flake.lock)
LOCKS_VALID_JSON
$ devenv version
devenv 2.1.2 (x86_64-linux)

assertions: task-2: pinned devenv + flake lockfiles present and valid JSON; devenv version resolves (devenv 2.1.2)

environment.cachix_devenv_version: devenv v2.1.2 (pinned in devenv.lock rev ea3d94ac9d6b)
